add_rc_deps(magnify.rc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/magnify.ico)

# magnify.exe is all Rust (magnify-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/magnify-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# magnifier.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/magnify-rust/src/magnify/magnifier.rs)
# settings.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/magnify-rust/src/magnify/settings.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(magnify_res OBJECT magnify.rc)
target_include_directories(magnify_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(MAGNIFY_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a)
add_cargo_module(magnify magnify-cargo magnify.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE magnify-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS magnify_res ${MAGNIFY_REUSED})
